name: – Konstantinos Arvanitis – After § 34 – Am 19
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: 34a. Expresses concern about the growing trend of judicialisation in political life, which may lead to the neutralisation of opponents through judicial means; asserts that respect for the rule of law prohibits any instrumentalisation of the judicial system, whether by EU institutions or national authorities, that would interfere in electoral processes; believes that the judiciary should serve as a bulwark against arbitrariness and not as a tool for political combat circumventing the ballot box;
